mece_decision_rules.accepted_high_confidence: Calibrated confidence >= 0.70 with valid bounding box and mask
mece_decision_rules.accepted_low_confidence: Calibrated confidence in [0.40, 0.70) with clear category margin
mece_decision_rules.rejected_ambiguous: Entropy > 1.8 or top confidence < 0.40, routed to user clarification UI
mece_decision_rules.rejected_invalid_input: Corrupted, empty, or unreadable image files
mece_decision_rules.rejected_unsupported: Out-of-domain categories outside canonical supported fashion taxonomy
mece_decision_rules.inference_failure: Runtime engine exceptions or hardware timeout
